sourceIssues.locator: §3, p.493, in the published version, Annals of Mathematics 192 (2020), 487–497 (publisher PDF, SHA-256 as recorded by the extraction); the same line is in arXiv 1907.13617v2
sourceIssues.printed: "This is a free Z-module 𝓛 ⊂ V_R of rank ℓ = C(d+r, d) − n. We set L = 𝓛 ⊗_Q R as the underlying R-vector space and L^⊥ as its orthogonal complement in V_R."
sourceIssues.correction: L = 𝓛 ⊗_Z R, the real span of 𝓛 in V_R (equivalently (𝓛 ⊗_Z Q) ⊗_Q R).
sourceIssues.reason: 𝓛 is defined one sentence earlier as a free Z-module, so a tensor product over Q is not defined for it; the intended object, used in the rest of the section, is its real span. Checked on the page image of p.493 and in the arXiv source (\cL\otimes_\QQ \RR). Noted by the extraction (item relation-lattice).
